compared.difference: Same source, different proposition: it counts the appendix theorem at source lines 2941-2943 with its proof at 2945-2984, on infinitely many pairwise inequivalent indiscernible sequences in a simple theory with SU(tp(b)) infinite. That statement involves EM-types and resolvability of indiscernible sequences in a strictly simple theory; it has no Morley rank, no omega-stability, no definable Morley sequence property and no nonminimality degree, and its proof is not used here.

A withdrawn card (worklist state needs_codex, ready-withdrawal reason recorded) counting Corollary eqnmfin at source lines 495-497 with proof material at 484-490 and 499-501, an inequality between the indiscernible forking degree and the degree of nonminimality for finite SU-rank types. The present unit is a different statement, a non-existence theorem for omega-stable types of limit Morley rank with definable Morley sequences, at source lines 2887-2897, in a different section, and uses neither eqnmfin nor its proof.
